extracted.name: All-purpose sesame sauce
extracted.description: Dress salad, steamed chicken, cold tofu etc. with this all-purpose sesame sauce. Make a lot and store it in a fridge. No additives, so it can be a save sauce for children! #Japanese #Chinese #Sesame #vegan
ingredient_lines: Roasted white sesame seeds: adjust to suit your needs
instruction_lines: Put all ingredients in a pot and mix together.
Heat over medium heat to reduce its liquid.
Add sesame seeds and mix them together.
Store in a jar and save in a fridge.
